context: LAYERED SCENERY: Build depth in this order: sky accents (sun/clouds or moon/stars), distant mountain, explicit lower ground such as meadow, then hills/river/path, then a focal house or tree, and finally bushes/flowers. A pleasing countryside scene usually has 7–10 objects over at least three layers. Keep the visual weight balanced: if a large mountain sits left, put the focal tree/house slightly right. Use offset_x and offset_y to avoid stacking objects on exactly the same anchor.
